verdict.rationale: Microsoft's official privacy FAQ explicitly states users can 'opt out of use of your conversation activity for model training' and describes when data does 'train our generative AI models' (copilot-docs-35, copilot-docs-36), directly delivering a training opt-out control. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the toggle works as described, and clarity on whether it covers all surfaces (a HN user noted confusion about whether Word-integrated Copilot content is auto-used for training, copilot-comm-6), and no evidence of granular per-app controls beyond the general FAQ.
